def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    hr = next(r for r in range(h) if all(v == 3 for v in grid[r]))
    vc = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Fill recursive bars outward from the cross. At each successive
    # scale, alternating rows and columns form the nested pattern.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r == hr or c == vc:
                continue
            y = abs(r - hr) - (1 if r > hr else 0)
            x = abs(c - vc) - (1 if c > vc else 0)
            # The pattern is the alternating binary expansion of the
            # coordinates, starting with the coarsest nonzero bit.
            bits = []
            while x or y:
                bits.append((x & 1, y & 1))
                x //= 2
                y //= 2
            fill = False
            for xb, yb in reversed(bits):
                if xb != yb:
                    fill = bool(xb)
            out[r][c] = 4 if fill else 0
    return out
